QuestInfo.name: Nella's Old Memory
QuestInfo.1: #p406# of #m10003000# seemed touched by #p402#'s gift. I should go let #p402# know. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: #p402# seemed pleased to hear that #p406# was happy with the gift. But it looks like he's still got another favor to ask, doesn't he?

0.0: I'm surprised #p402# still remembered something from back then. Actually, I used to be someone who couldn't really trust other people either, wandering from place to place until I settled down here in #m10003000#. I figured this city would be no different from anywhere else.
0.1: But the people here were different. Everyone seemed to do their own thing, sure, but somehow, being around each other, we ended up learning to respect one another and figuring out how to survive. When #p402# first arrived in this city, I saw a bit of my old self in him. So I just taught #p402# what I'd learned, that's all.
0.2: Thanks to you, I'm remembering some old memories I hadn't thought about in a while. Anyway, tell #p402# I said thanks for the gift, and that I'm looking forward to more good times ahead!

yes.0: Hm? What was inside the gift box? Heh, that's a secret just between me and #p402#!

no.0: Are you trying to back out this time just because there's no reward?

1.0: You're back! Did you deliver my gift to #p406# alright? Did #p406# not say anything else?

npc.0: I had no idea #p402# still remembered that, after all this time. Be sure to tell him I said thanks for the gift, alright?
